segments.t: Configure terminal recording and replay options. These settings control how korTTY captures and replays terminal sessions, including color preservation and automatic recording availability. Open via KTPH001Configuration → Global Settings → VideoKTPH002; stored in KTPH000.
Enable terminal recording after app restart

Enabling KTPH000Capture terminal colors in recordingsKTPH001 stores per-cell terminal color information in new replay files. This increases the replay file size but preserves the original terminal appearance, including ANSI colors and background colors, for accurate replay.
